name: Easy and Transparent Business.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Saga Telecom is now being digital and paperless to be efficient and eco-friendly.
Necessary information will be shared online ONLY(not on A4 paper).
To realize this,
A google drive folder under your country and your name will be created
The original editors will be the email(s) from the invoice and s.sagatelecom@gmail.com
Please use the original email(s) to adjust the access availability.
This folder usually includes below information of each order
Datasheet
User Manual
Certificate of Warranty
Warranty Policy
Web Manual, CLI Manual(for managed models only)
Product photos
Shipping document
Details about this order
Remark
A printed copy of user manual is included in the packing box.
When a client needs something urgently, but the salesperson cannot reply timely
When a client needs to submit something internally
When a client needs to look into the product details
...
This google drive link will be very helpful.
